list.title: Bookings
list.description: Reservations, pickups and returns across your branches
list.emptyDescription: Try adjusting the search or filters.
list.draftsEmptyDescription: Start a booking and choose Save draft to come back to it later.
list.exportTooLarge: {{total}} bookings match, and at most {{limit}} can be exported at once. Narrow the filters and try again.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: Rentals across your fleet, by date
calendar.legend: Show or hide bookings by status

year.legend: Share of the fleet out each day

noVehicles.title: No vehicles to schedule yet
noVehicles.description: Add a vehicle and its rentals will be laid out here by date.

noMatches.title: Nothing matches
noMatches.description: Try another name, plate or reference, or pick a different branch.

details.notFoundDescription: We couldn't find that booking. It may have been cancelled.

description.pickup: Record the car as it leaves. The return is measured against these readings.
description.return: Record the car as it comes back.

condition.odometerInvalid: Enter the miles on the odometer as a whole number.
condition.odometerBelowPickup: That is less than the {{miles}} read at pickup.
condition.odometerBelowFile: Lower than the {{miles}} on the vehicle's file. Check the reading.

notes.pickup: Marks and damage already on the car

condition.notesHint: Leave blank if there is none.

photos.label: Photos
photos.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB each.

rejected.type: {{name}} is not a JPEG, PNG or WebP

drivers.title: Additional drivers
drivers.hint: Check each driver's licence card against the person in front of you. Fill in or correct the details from the card.
drivers.absent: A driver who isn't here can't drive. Cancel, remove them under Drivers, then hand over.

problem.incomplete: Enter {{name}}'s licence number, state and expiry from the card.
problem.expired: {{name}}'s licence has expired, so they can't drive.

payment.title: Payment
payment.balanceHint: Still to collect from the renter
payment.holdTiming: A card hold lasts about 7 days, so request it close to pickup to cover the whole rental.
payment.holdStarts: The hold lasts about 7 days from when the renter authorises it.
payment.overpaidHint: Paid above the total after a change. Refund it below.

manage.title: Manage booking
manage.subtitle: Change the rental while it is open

hints.addDriver: Name another driver on the agreement
hints.swapVehicle: Put the renter in a different car

cancelOff.not_confirmed: Not accepted yet: decline the request instead.
cancelOff.vehicle_out: The vehicle is out: take it back to end the rental.

changeOff.not_before_pickup: The vehicle is out: extend the rental or take it back instead.

renter.title: Renter
renter.licenceAtPickup: Licence to be checked at pickup

checkHints.background: Driving record and watchlist verification, run before the branch confirms.
checkHints.identity: Driving licence and a selfie match are required before handover.
checkHints.insurance: Proof of cover, or the branch waiver, must be on file.

agreement.title: Rental agreement
agreement.blockingHandover: The keys can't be handed over until this is signed.

activity.title: Activity
activity.empty: Nothing has happened on this booking yet.

actions.pendingApi: This needs the bookings API, which isn't live yet.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel this booking?
cancelDialog.description: {{reference}} for {{name}} will be cancelled and the vehicle freed for other rentals. This can't be undone.
cancelDialog.unavailable: This booking can't be cancelled now.
cancelDialog.nothingPaid: Nothing has been paid on this booking, so there is nothing to refund.
cancelDialog.policyNow: Cancelling now, this booking's policy refunds {{percent}}%: {{amount}}.
cancelDialog.policyNonRefundable: This booking is non-refundable under its cancellation policy.
cancelDialog.noPolicy: This booking has no cancellation policy, so what to refund is your decision.
cancelDialog.refundOver: That is more than was paid.

effects.title: What cancelling does
effects.toCard: {{amount}} goes back to the card the renter paid with.
effects.byHand: {{amount}} was paid in person. Hand it back yourself; it is recorded as refunded.
effects.link: The payment link already sent stops working.
effects.email: {{name}} is emailed that the booking is cancelled, with the reason.
effects.noEmail: Email isn't set up, so {{name}} won't be told. Let them know yourself.

cancelDialog.messageHint: Optional. Emailed to the renter with the reason.
cancelDialog.messageHintNoEmail: Optional. Kept on the booking; email isn't set up, so it is not sent.

renterMismatch.title: Who is this renter?
renterMismatch.subtitle: What they typed online differs from the customer on file with this email. Settle it before accepting.
renterMismatch.emailTitle: A different person needs their own email
renterMismatch.emailDescription: {{email}} belongs to the customer on file. Enter this renter's own email to save them as a separate customer.

renterDuplicates.title: This renter may already be a customer
renterDuplicates.subtitle: Another customer has the same licence number, or the same name and date of birth. If they are the same person, merge the two from the customer page before running checks.

request.title: Renter's request
request.subtitle: What the renter asked for when they reserved online.

preference.online_rental_only: Rental online, deposit at the counter

declineDialog.title: Decline this reservation?
declineDialog.description: {{reference}} for {{name}} will be cancelled. You can restore it until its pickup time.
declineDialog.withdrawsLink: The payment link already sent to them will stop working.
declineDialog.messageHint: Optional. Emailed to the renter with the reason.

closeDialog.title: Close this booking?
closeDialog.description: {{reference}} will be marked Completed. After that nothing on it can be changed, including its return charges.

restoreDialog.title: Restore this reservation?
restoreDialog.description: {{reference}} goes back to Pending for you to confirm or decline again, and {{name}} is emailed that it is under review. A payment link the decline withdrew stays cancelled.

effects.title: What the change also does
effects.agreement: The rental agreement is voided. Issue it again to be signed before pickup.
effects.link: The link already sent stops working. Send a new one.
effects.hold: The deposit hold is released. Request it again for the new amount.
effects.refund: {{amount}} is owed back to {{name}}. Refund it from the payment card.
effects.noEmail: Email isn't set up, so {{name}} won't be told. Let them know yourself.

errors.not_before_pickup: The vehicle has been picked up, so the dates and the vehicle can no longer change.
errors.vehicle_unavailable: Another booking has this vehicle on those dates.
errors.vehicle_not_found: This vehicle is no longer in the fleet.
errors.vehicle_removed: The booking's vehicle was deleted, so its dates can't be priced. Swap in another vehicle first.
errors.vehicle_has_no_rates: This vehicle has no rates to price the rental at.
errors.window_not_ordered: The return has to be after the pickup.
errors.return_in_past: That return time has already passed.
errors.rental_too_long: A rental can be at most 365 days.
errors.nothing_changed: The booking is already like this.
errors.quote_changed: The price changed while this was open. Check the new figure and confirm again.
errors.payment_processing: The renter's last payment is still going through. Try again in a moment.

dates.title: Modify dates
dates.description: Move the pickup, the return, or both. The whole rental is priced again for its new dates.

problems.notOrdered: The return has to be after the pickup.
problems.inPast: That return time has already passed.
problems.tooLong: A rental can be at most {{days}} days.

dates.clashOut: {{reference}} still has this vehicle out. It was due back {{to}}.

swap.title: Swap vehicle
swap.description: Put {{name}} in a different car for the same dates.
swap.keepPriceHint: For a free upgrade, or a swap that is your doing. Otherwise the rental is priced at the new vehicle's rates.
swap.noneTitle: No other vehicle to swap to
swap.noneDescription: Every other vehicle is archived, in service or off the road.

toast.declinedEmailQueued: An email with the reason is on its way to {{name}}.
toast.renterNotNotified: Email isn't set up, so {{name}} was not told. Message them yourself.
toast.restoredEmailQueued: An email is on its way to {{name}} saying it is under review again.
toast.renterSettleFailed: Couldn't save who the renter is
toast.cancelledEmailQueued: An email is on its way to {{name}}.
toast.cancelledByHand: Hand {{amount}} back to the renter in person.
toast.changedAgreement: The agreement was voided: issue it again.
toast.changedDeposit: The deposit hold was released: request it again.
toast.changedEmailQueued: An email is on its way to {{name}} with what changed.

sections.tripHint: When and where the rental starts and ends. Availability is checked as you change dates.

fields.locationEmpty: No branches yet. Add one under Settings before taking a booking.

vehicle.title: Available vehicles
vehicle.noneDescription: Nothing is on the forecourt here. Try another pickup location.

rate.hint: Chosen for the trip length: a rate that fits it exactly wins, otherwise the cheapest combination, less any length-of-rental discount.
rate.none: This vehicle has no rate options yet.

customer.hint: Search the customer book, or type a name that is not on file yet.
customer.searchHint: Picking someone fills in their details below — you can still edit them.

review.termsNotKept: This draft was saved with the terms “{{name}}”. Bookings now start on your default terms, so pick “{{name}}” again on the booking before its agreement is sent.
review.termsNotKeptUnnamed: This draft was saved with its own rental terms. Bookings now start on your default terms, so pick them again on the booking before its agreement is sent.

draft.savedDescription: Pick this booking back up from New booking.
draft.restoredDescription: We brought back the booking you were part-way through.
draft.savedWithoutDocuments: Saved. The licence and insurance scans were not kept — please attach them again when you resume.
draft.loadError: Could not load the draft. It was not opened, so nothing has been changed.
draft.missing: It may have been discarded or already turned into a booking.
draft.notDiscarded: Booking {{reference}} was created, but its draft could not be removed. Discard it from the Drafts tab so it is not booked twice.

documents.hint: Attach scans or photos. Both are optional here and can be added at handover.
documents.licenceHint: Front of the card, or a clear photo
documents.uploadFailed: Booking created, but a document did not upload
documents.uploadFailedDescription: {{documents}} could not be attached. You can upload it again from the renter's record.
documents.replacedHint: Attaching a new file replaces the one on file.

verification.hint: Screen the renter and confirm their insurance before the keys change hands.

drivers.hint: Anyone else permitted to drive. Each is billed per rental day.
drivers.empty: No additional drivers — the renter is the only permitted driver.
drivers.name: Full name

fees.hint: One-off charges added to this booking — cleaning, a negotiated add-on, anything outside the standard rate.
fees.empty: No additional fees on this booking.
fees.label: Description

background.notStarted: Searches criminal records against the name and date of birth on this booking.
background.running: Checkr is still searching. This is usually done in seconds.
background.clear: No records were found for this renter.
background.consider: Records were found. Read the report before handover.
background.error: Checkr could not run this check. Running it again starts over.
background.expired: The last check on file is too old to count. Run it again.

insurance.notStarted: The renter connects their own insurer, and we check that an active policy lists them. One check stands until that policy expires.
insurance.running: Waiting for the renter to connect their insurer. Send the link again if they lost it.
insurance.clear: An active policy lists this renter.
insurance.consider: The policy does not clear this renter on its own. Check it before handing over keys.
insurance.error: Axle could not finish this check. Starting again opens a new session.
insurance.expired: The insurance verified for this renter has run out. Send the link to verify it again.

toast.orderedDescription: The result is on the checklist.
toast.orderFailed: Could not run the background check
toast.insuranceFailed: Could not start the insurance check
toast.insuranceUnfinished: The renter did not finish connecting their insurance. Their link still works.
toast.insuranceReplaced: That insurance link was replaced by a newer one, which is still waiting for the renter.

background.label: Background check
background.checking: Checking whether this renter has been screened…
background.none: Nothing on file for this renter. Running it now takes a few seconds.
background.running: Checkr is searching. The result appears here when it lands.
background.clearOn: Checked {{when}} · nothing found, no need to run it again
background.recordsOn: Checked {{when}} · records were found, read the report before handing over keys
background.needsRenter: Add the renter’s full name, email and date of birth first — Checkr matches on all three.

insurance.label: Insurance verification
insurance.checking: Checking whether this renter’s insurance has been verified…
insurance.none: Nothing on file. Send the renter a link to connect their insurer on their own phone.
insurance.running: Waiting for the renter to connect their insurer. The result appears here when they finish.
insurance.clearOn: Checked {{when}} · an active policy lists this renter
insurance.recordsOn: Checked {{when}} · the policy does not clear this renter, check it before handing over keys
insurance.needsRenter: Add the renter’s full name, email and date of birth first. The policy has to list this renter, and the result is saved against their email.
insurance.needsDob: This renter has no date of birth on file. Add it to their profile first.
insurance.expiredOn: Ran out {{when}} · send the link to verify again

validity.endsBeforeReturn: Runs out {{date}}, before this rental's return

verificationPage.title: Verification
verificationPage.description: Run a criminal background check or verify insurance on anyone — a renter, a contractor, a new hire.

form.title: Who are you checking?
form.hint: Pick a check, then who it is for. Every check matches on the name and date of birth.
form.name: Full name
form.addressHint: Optional. Narrows the search to where they have lived — fill in all four or leave them blank.

background.title: Background check
background.description: Searches criminal records on the name and date of birth.

insurance.title: Insurance
insurance.description: They connect their insurer from a secure link on their own phone.

next.background: The result appears in the list below, usually within seconds.
next.insurance: You get a link to copy or send them. The result appears below when they finish.

log.title: Verification history
log.empty: No checks yet. Run one above.
log.deleteDescription: The {{check}} for {{name}} is removed from the history for good. The audit log keeps a record of the deletion.

insuranceLink.title: Send insurance link
insuranceLink.description: {{name}} connects their insurer from this link, on any device. The result appears on the check when they finish.
insuranceLink.copyFailed: Could not copy the link. Select it and copy it instead.
insuranceLink.sendingSoon: Sending by email or text is coming soon. For now, copy the link and send it to the renter yourself.

done.title: Your insurance is connected
done.body: Thank you. You can close this page — the rental company has what it needs.

unfinished.title: Insurance not connected yet
unfinished.body: The connection was not finished. Open the link you were sent again to try once more.

failed.title: Something went wrong
failed.body: We could not finish checking your insurance. Open the link again, or contact the rental company.

replaced.title: This link has been replaced
replaced.body: The rental company has sent you a newer link. Open that one to connect your insurance.
